_comment: Per-record dispositions for feedback arrivals, keyed (env|estate|channel|record id). ⛔ THIS FILE IS TRACKED IN A PUBLIC REPO. No note text and no personId ever land here — the words live in .private/ and person ids live in the private sibling's grants.json. A `why` is written by a human and goes public with it: say where the record went, never what anybody said. A batch may never be cleared by one of its members, so there is no bulk write and no watermark.

home|est-e6696a|feedback|fb-vurlf77f-mtt.why: [paul-ruled 2026-09-08 at DISPOSE] FOLDS INTO TIER 1 · 11 (the weather card from an address), which already owns the household's-own-station opt-in. Paul: 'I think we have something about this covered in the backlog in weather, but let's just add this to that as additional evidence.' ⭐ WHAT THE EVIDENCE ADDS: the product conflates TWO different states — 'your station is offline' (a fault) and 'you have no station' (a fact about a condo). Wide-eyed saw the CORRECT form at QA on the same build — the station row read 'No station here — regional readings' — so the honest string exists and the wrong one is reaching production. ⚠️ It also converges with row 11's existing Q4 member in TIER 2 · 16, Paul's own earlier walk line: 'if you ask me for the station, remove the indicator' — same defect, reported twice, weeks apart, by the same person on two different origins. ⛔⛔ MECHANISM CORRECTED AT READ (beat 3), 2026-09-08 — the reason above named the WRONG CAUSE and is kept rather than rewritten so the correction is legible. It said 'the wrong branch is reaching a household.' FALSE, verified against the SHIPPED production build (fernwood-home.pages.dev/viewer, 1,212,428 bytes, ESTATE_STATION = "declared-absent"): the RIGHT branch is reaching it. The calm path fires correctly and renders the honest sentence — and ships it inside a status dot: `(STATION_DECLARED_ABSENT ? ' No station here - regional readings' : ...)`. The code's own comment states it: 'the CALM path... the card says "No station here - regional readings" WITH A STALE DOT.' ⭐ SO IT IS RIGHT WORDS, WRONG COMPONENT: an amber degradation dot beside a sentence saying nothing is wrong. A DECLARATION IS NOT A STATUS, and rendering one in the status vocabulary is what Paul read as an offline indicator. The fix is smaller and different from what was scoped here: suppress the dot when the station is declared absent. Found by the user-researcher seat at READ; confirmed by reading the deployed artifact, not the source. ⭐⭐ AND IT IS A CLASS, NOT A STRING: viewer.html:16736 ('Station offline - pressure & rain from the forecast grid') gates on RUNTIME LIVENESS and ignores the declaration entirely — latent at the condo only because fishing is absent there.
